versions.title: Initial Release of Miscellaneous System asd
newFeatures: Implemented the Miscellaneous System inside the WSP platform, accessible after user login
Added a dedicated Miscellaneous page for taxpayers
Introduced selectable miscellaneous certificates/services for payment
Added service descriptions and automatic total amount computation
Enabled users to proceed directly to payment from the Miscellaneous module
Integrated SPIDC Universal Checkout payment system
Enabled automatic generation of receipt / EOR (Electronic Official Receipt) after successful payment
improvements: Streamlined navigation from WSP system to Miscellaneous module for faster access
Improved user payment flow with a direct checkout process (reduced steps)
Enhanced clarity of service selection through structured descriptions and pricing display
Improved system integration between Miscellaneous module and SPIDC payment gateway
